title: refactor(core,react): home the non-grid row ceiling in core; the note takes the result (objectui#7508)
body:
Fixes #7508
Clause-②: yes — two packages' public API moves (maintainer ruling A′, comment 5529427804)

Follow-up to objectui#7210 (already completed), executing ruling A′ as recorded on objectui#7508.

## Public surface, per package

**`@object-ui/core` — added**

| name | kind | change |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `NON_GRID_ROW_CEILING` | const | moved from `@object-ui/react`, value unchanged |
| `applyNonGridRowCeiling` | function | moved from `@object-ui/react`, behaviour unchanged |
| `NonGridCeilingResult` | type | moved from `@object-ui/react`, shape unchanged |
| `nonGridRowCeilingQuery` | function returning `{ $top }` | **new** — the one place the probe row's `+ 1` is written |

**`@object-ui/react`**

| name | change |
|:--|:--|
| `NON_GRID_ROW_CEILING`, `applyNonGridRowCeiling`, type `NonGridCeilingResult` | kept, now `export … from '@object-ui/core'` — the same bindings (pinned by identity) |
| `NON_GRID_ROW_CEILING_TOP` | **deleted**, not re-exported |
| `NonGridRowCeilingNote` | **reshaped**: its only prop is `result: NonGridCeilingResult`. `drawn`, `total`, `truncated` and `className` are gone, no deprecated path |
| `nonGridRowCeilingQuery` | not re-exported: the ruling puts the `+ 1` in one exported helper, and core is its home |

Release status, measured: the npm registry's latest `@object-ui/react` tarball (17.6.0) contains none of the five names (positive control: `extractWriteErrorMessage` hits 5 files in the same tarball), and `.changeset/7210-non-grid-row-ceiling.md` is still pending. So the deletion and the prop reshape reach no released consumer.

## What changed

- `packages/core/src/utils/non-grid-row-ceiling.ts` (new, beside `extract-records.ts`) and one core barrel line. The ruling-a′ docblock (the 2,000 measurement table) moved with the constant.
- `packages/react/src/utils/nonGridRowCeiling.tsx` keeps only the note. It prints `result.rows.length` and `result.total` and decides on `result.truncated`. It now carries `shrink-0` itself: the only styling any caller passed was the gantt's `shrink-0` class string, and that is a no-op outside a flex container.
- `packages/react/src/index.ts`: the three names re-exported from core; the stale "OPEN maintainer decision" comment replaced.
- `ObjectCalendar`, `ObjectGantt`, `ObjectMap`, `ObjectTree`: the helpers come from the `@object-ui/core` import block each file already had. Every `$top` site spreads `nonGridRowCeilingQuery()` (calendar 2, gantt 1, map 2, tree 2). The `rowCeiling` state holds the `NonGridCeilingResult` itself, or `null` on the host-data paths that used to reset it to `truncated: false`. The note is mounted with `result={rowCeiling}` only while a result is held. What they fetch, draw and print is unchanged.
- Tests: the helper pins and `contractEnvelope-6839` moved to `packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/`, the react test now pins only the note and the re-export, and 11 plugin test files moved off the deleted constant onto `nonGridRowCeilingQuery().$top`.
- `packages/react/README.md` "NON_GRID_ROW_CEILING" section rewritten to the new shape (heading kept). `.changeset/7508-non-grid-ceiling-to-core.md`: `minor` on `core` and `react`, with every moved, new, removed and reshaped name.

## The ruling's two pins

1. **The four renderers agree on one ceiling and one `+ 1`.** Every renderer test that reads the wire (`rowCeiling-7210`, `inlineQueryKeys-*`, `elementDataSource`, `hostDataProp-7210`) asserts `$top === nonGridRowCeilingQuery().$top`, and each row-ceiling pin asserts the note names `NON_GRID_ROW_CEILING`. Core pins the query as exactly `{ $top: NON_GRID_ROW_CEILING + 1 }`, holding only `$top`, and a fresh object on every call.
2. **The note cannot render a drawn/total pair that did not come from a result.** Four `@ts-expect-error` lines, one each for `drawn`, `total`, `truncated` and a missing `result`, are compiled by react's `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` (`--listFiles` confirms the file is in that program). A runtime case forces the loose props past the compiler and shows they are ignored. A third case uses a truncated result of 7 rows and shows the note prints 7, not the constant.

## Verification — all runs at `ae0a5b7`

- Build closure: `@object-ui/react...`, `@object-ui/core...`, the four plugins' `^...` closures, then the `check-doc-snippet-types --build-filter` closure (turbo `Tasks: 35 successful, 35 total`), then console — all exit 0.
- Tests (repo-root vitest, `--maxWorkers=2`): `packages/core/` 168 files / 3509 passed; `packages/react/` 94 / 1291; `plugin-calendar` + `plugin-map` + `plugin-tree` 85 / 556; `plugin-gantt` 72 / 558. The 35 test files outside those six packages that name a changed file (types, i18n, components, plugin-list, plugin-grid, plugin-view, apps/console, examples/schema-catalog, scripts/__tests__) also pass: 35 / 1852.
- `type-check` (the `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` pair) for core, react, calendar, gantt, map and tree: all six `Done`. `lint` for the same six: 0 errors. The only warnings on the new core module are the 4 `no-explicit-any`, moved verbatim from the react module.
- Gate verdict lines:
  - `check-changeset-presence`: "23 source file(s) of 6 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)".
  - `check-changeset-no-major`: "No changeset declares a `major` bump". `check-changeset-fixed` ✅. `check-changeset-overwrite`: "No pre-existing changeset was modified or deleted".

  - `check:sdui-registration-pins`: "All 16 registration(s) … present". `check:eager-closure` ✅ (headroom 61.2 KB). `check:side-effects-array` ✅.

## Reverse verification / ablation

These ran on the committed tree through `ablation-replace.mjs`. Each run confirmed the anchor count went down and the target text count went up before any test ran. Each restore is proven: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

1. `nonGridRowCeilingQuery` drops the `+ 1`. Predicted: the core pins go red and the renderer pins stay green. **Observed: 8 failed / 11 passed.** The 4 core pins and the envelope pin went red. So did 2 gantt row-ceiling cases and the tree row-ceiling case: those fakes honour `$top`, so exactly 2,000 rows came back and nothing was truncated. That is more red than predicted, and it means the renderer pins also depend on the one `+ 1`.
2. The note prints the constant instead of `result.rows.length`: 2 failed / 5 passed (the two result-count cases), as predicted.
3. The note's prop type re-admits `drawn`: react `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 2 with `TS2578: Unused '@ts-expect-error' directive` on the `drawn` line, as predicted.
4. `ObjectTree`'s object arm writes `$top: 2000` instead of the spread: tree row-ceiling pin 1 failed / 1 passed, as predicted.
5. The README snippet reverts to the three-prop call: `check-doc-snippet-types` reports "673 of 673 block(s) judged, 1 failed" with TS2322 on `packages/react/README.md` (`drawn` does not exist on the note's props).

## Acceptance notes

- **Three edits outside the claimed surface**, all required by the move:
  - (a) one comment bullet in `packages/core/src/utils/extract-records.ts` now points at the moved call site. The move made the old path false.
  - (b) the react helper test and `contractEnvelope-6839` moved into core's `__tests__` together with the module they test.
  - (c) seven plugin test files beyond the row-ceiling ones imported the deleted constant: `ObjectCalendar.inlineQueryKeys-9061`, `ObjectGantt.elementDataSource`, `ObjectGantt.hostDataProp-7210`, `ObjectGantt.inlineQueryKeys-8769`, `ObjectMap.elementDataSource`, `ObjectMap.inlineQueryKeys-9061`, `ObjectTree.inlineQueryKeys-9136`.
- **Pending `.changeset/7210-non-grid-row-ceiling.md` still names `NON_GRID_ROW_CEILING_TOP`.** It lists it as a new react export and says the fetches ask for it. I did not edit it: it is outside the claim, and `check-changeset-overwrite` watches that file. This PR's changeset says outright that it supersedes that export list. Carrier: the dispatching seat, if a one-sentence amendment to that pending body is wanted before release.
- **`className` was removed from `NonGridRowCeilingNote`.** I read the ruling's "nothing else" literally. Flagged for the contract review.
- `content/docs/guide/data-source.md` still describes `NON_GRID_ROW_CEILING` as a `@object-ui/react` export. That is still true through the re-export, so I left it.
- `packages/plugin-markdown/src/toc.ts` uses `### NON_GRID_ROW_CEILING` only as a slugging example, and its parity test works on a literal string. The react README heading it mirrors is kept, so nothing moves.
- Serial: objectui#7750 is queued behind this PR on the core barrel. I did not touch `packages/core/src/data-scope/`.
- Deviation: commit `ae0a5b7` carries a model-named `Co-Authored-By` trailer. I did not rewrite it, because this repo bans force-push.
